Theorem
[Cheeger--Gromoll splitting] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0483 ↗ prop:chow-iii-i12-i17-busemann-convexity 1. appi:1.18\group Nonnegative curvature and Busemann functions

If $(\M ^n,g)$ is complete with $\operatorname {Rc}\ge 0$ and contains a geodesic line, then $(\M ,g)$ is isometric to $\R \times (\N ^{n-1},h)$ with $\operatorname {Rc}_h\ge 0$.
